decision.reason: SportsDataverse lost all 20 position/stat groups to both FFToday and Native V2 on its documented clean 2024 holdout.

methodology.why_2024_only: SportsDataverse documents 2022-2023 as fitting folds and 2024 as the untouched holdout; applying current fitted constants to earlier seasons would not be an independent historical backtest.
methodology.season_total_composition: SportsDataverse projected raw-stat per-game rates multiplied by its separately projected availability games.

implementation_note.null_age_workaround: The package aging-curve function crashed on a null-age bucket. Benchmark excludes null ages only from aging-curve fitting; projected players retain the package's fallback-age behavior.

commercial_governance.reason: Software licensing does not clear all underlying NFL data-provider rights. In particular, the availability path uses nflverse snap-count data whose upstream provenance requires separate rights review.
